# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-24 from the 2026-11-24 Hub dump.

- 3,261,626 models tracked, 944,407 declare a base model, 977,869 parent links, 93,987 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
